articles.title: Trump Threatens to 'Annihilate' Iran — While US and Iran Talk Behind the Scenes
articles.summary: President Trump told the UN he could 'annihilate' Iran if no deal is reached — but on the same day, US and Iranian officials held indirect talks through a Qatari mediator. Trump says a deal may come after November's elections.

articles.title: Zelenskyy Offers 'Energy Truce' with Russia — But Can It Hold?
articles.summary: Ukraine's President Zelenskyy says Kyiv will stop striking Russian oil refineries if Moscow stops hitting Ukraine's power grid. He met Trump for 40 minutes in New York. But a previous truce collapsed almost immediately.

articles.title: Broken Cable, Broken System: Aging Air Traffic Control Halts Hundreds of Flights
articles.summary: A failed communications switch — plus a backup line accidentally cut by railroad workers — grounded hundreds of flights across the Northeast on Monday. Officials say the 40-year-old system needs a $20 billion overhaul.
